animation_notes.turns: Sample root yaw as a delta from the entity's start yaw. Commit the 90-degree entity heading once and clear the turn animation; do not add the final yaw twice.
animation_notes.walk: Loop is in-place. Movement and pathfinding remain the Java entity's responsibility.
animation_notes.head: Separate look clips return to neutral. Runtime may drive/clamp head yaw/pitch directly instead.
animation_notes.light: Lamp texels/mask only describe appearance. No beam is included, and actual world illumination is not provided by these files.
